title: Debugging Training
learning_objectives: Check a model and loss by overfitting a single small batch
Recognise diverging, stuck and healthy loss curves
Measure gradient norms and tame exploding gradients with clipping
entry_point: diagnose(losses); overfit_one_batch(model, X, y, steps=200, lr=0.01); train_with_clipping(model, X, y, lr, steps, max_norm=None)
hints: `diagnose`: check `math.isfinite` for every loss first, then compare the last loss with the first.
Both training functions use the usual cycle: zero_grad, loss, backward, (clip), step.

failure_feedback.advice: Check for non-finite values first, then last > 2 × first, then last > 0.95 × first.
Train with CrossEntropyLoss and Adam for the given steps and return the final loss.
Call clip_grad_norm_ after backward() and before step().
Record each loss before the update, using MSELoss and SGD.
